description:
The authoritative field reference for the `PitchApplication` payload.

**When:** call this FIRST in every session. Cache the response.
**Before you call:** nothing — no inputs.
**Returns:** markdown listing every field, type, limit, enum, plus a
complete valid example.

With this in context, you can assemble a payload that validates on the
first `create_application`.
name: get_application_schema
